desk:
**BLUF:** The OSINT/defence community focused on Russian missile/drone strikes into Ukraine and Iranian threats to close southern oil-shuttle routes through the Strait of Hormuz. The single most important thread is the Hormuz escalation, with multiple @sentdefender posts detailing IRGC statements and U.S. naval support.

## MAIN THREADS

### Russian Missile Attack on Ukraine
- [@Osinttechnical](https://x.com/Osinttechnical/status/2107696030275756120) reported a major Russian Kh-101 strike on Kremenchuk residential areas causing major damage.
- [@Osinttechnical](https://x.com/Osinttechnical/status/2107696255061434424) shared local Ukrainian channels confirming the eastern/central city strikes.

### Strait of Hormuz Oil Shuttles & IRGC Threats
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2107834896852951331) posted IRGC statement via Fars that southern transit routes will be blocked soon.
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2107835564040851954) assessed this follows recent export spikes and centers on nuclear talks.
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2107878072904974696) detailed Bloomberg reporting on U.S. Navy/jet support for the shuttle system.

### Ukrainian Drone Raid into Russia
- [@Osinttechnical](https://x.com/Osinttechnical/status/2107633512073269411) reported ongoing Ukrainian drone activity deep into the Volga River Valley.

### MiG-29 Drone Shootdown over Kyiv
- [@Osinttechnical](https://x.com/Osinttechnical/status/2107885822112645198) posted footage of a Ukrainian MiG-29 downing a Geran-4 drone at close range with cannon fire.

### Nidal Hasan Execution Order
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2107647938650398886) reported Acting Secretary of the Army order for firing-squad execution on 3 Dec 2026, citing @SecArmy.

## CONTESTED
Nothing contested.

## SINGLE-SOURCE CLAIMS
- Syrian President al-Sharaa discussed possible Houthis involvement with Saudi Crown Prince; no decision yet [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2107787902075670593) (unconfirmed).
- Three-year anniversary of Hamas Oct 7 attack still imprinted on minds [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2107766788075487568) (unconfirmed).

## WORTH WATCHING
Analysts watching for Iranian follow-through on Hormuz strikes and any U.S. naval response. Ukrainian drone/missile exchanges expected to continue overnight. No further major Syria developments flagged.
